reason: Having someone come to the house while the kids nap sounds nice, but ₱1,800 is a lot of our monthly budget for one set of nails. The gel art I get at the mall costs much less, so I'll save their page and wait until I have an event.
objection: ₱1,800 for one person is too much for me in a normal month, and I haven't seen their portfolio yet, so I don't know if the designs are worth it.
would_change_my_mind: A first-booking promo around ₱1,000 to ₱1,200, plus an Instagram or TikTok portfolio of real client nails that look as good as the designs I save.
